primary_reason.zh: 循环更新环境潜状态以进行未来模拟，主要研究世界预测的模型设计。

primary_reason.en: It parses, generates, and places objects to reconstruct editable simulation scenes and world assets.
primary_reason.zh: 解析、生成并放置对象以重建可编辑仿真场景，主要产物是世界资产。

primary_reason.en: It learns generalist action models for digital and physical environments through shared spatial-action supervision.
primary_reason.zh: 通过统一空间动作监督学习数字与物理环境中的通用行动模型。

primary_reason.en: It organizes data, harness, and model-improvement operations into recursive self-improvement workflows.
primary_reason.zh: 组合数据、脚手架和模型改进操作，主要研究自改进流程的组织。

primary_reason.en: It learns robot dynamics that replace physics solvers, primarily providing an environment-transition model.
primary_reason.zh: 学习可替代物理求解器的机器人动力学，主要提供环境状态转移模型。

primary_reason.en: It learns GUI and robot actions through hierarchical sharing and separate experts, delivering cross-domain policies.
primary_reason.zh: 以分层共享与专家分离学习GUI和机器人动作，主要输出跨域策略。

primary_reason.en: It redesigns action representation, decoding, and fine-tuning to improve robot-policy success and speed.
primary_reason.zh: 改造动作表示、解码与微调目标，主要提升机器人策略成功率和速度。

primary_reason.en: It compares action-interaction designs on a shared video backbone, primarily delivering evaluable world-action policies.
primary_reason.zh: 在共同视频骨干上比较动作交互设计，主要交付可评测的世界动作策略。

primary_reason.en: It transforms logical RL workflows into efficient hardware execution through resource and pipeline scheduling.
primary_reason.zh: 把RL逻辑工作流转换为高效硬件执行，主要贡献是资源与流水调度。

primary_reason.en: It unifies real-robot collection, asynchronous training, and persistent replay as online-learning infrastructure.
primary_reason.zh: 统一真实机器人采集、异步训练与持久回放，优化在线学习基础设施。

primary_reason.en: It combines textual reasoning and visual imagination into embodied plans, with action generation extending that planning capability.
primary_reason.zh: 联合文字推理与视觉想象形成具身计划，动作生成是该规划能力的扩展。

primary_reason.en: It expands internal computation through shared recurrent depth, contributing language-model architecture.
primary_reason.zh: 通过共享循环深度扩展模型内部计算，主要贡献是语言模型结构。

primary_reason.en: It repeatedly revises answers using natural-language feedback, studying problem-solving workflows without additional training.
primary_reason.zh: 以自然语言反馈反复修改当前答案，研究无额外训练的求解流程。

primary_reason.en: It improves VLAs through exploration, rewards, and policy updates, contributing a robot reinforcement-learning recipe.
primary_reason.zh: 通过探索、奖励与策略更新改善VLA，主要贡献是机器人强化学习配方。

primary_reason.en: It bootstraps reasoning data through generation, correction, and fine-tuning loops, studying a self-improvement workflow.
primary_reason.zh: 以生成、纠错和再微调循环自举推理数据，主要研究自改进学习流程。

primary_reason.en: It recursively rewrites optimization scaffolds with fixed language models, contributing program-search workflows.
primary_reason.zh: 固定语言模型递归改写优化脚手架，主要创新在程序搜索流程。

primary_reason.en: It changes network depth structure through recurrent shared self-attention and adaptive stopping.
primary_reason.zh: 以共享循环自注意力和动态停止改变网络深度结构。

primary_reason.en: It coordinates compute and graphics scheduling on one GPU, contributing low-level resource management.
primary_reason.zh: 打通计算与图形调度以共享同一GPU，主要贡献是底层资源管理。

primary_reason.en: It compares action-model robustness under visual and language perturbations, evaluating robot policies.
primary_reason.zh: 比较动作模型在视觉和语言扰动下的控制鲁棒性，评估对象是机器人策略。

primary_reason.en: It empirically compares asynchronous inference and action-continuation strategies, studying deployment and execution tradeoffs.
primary_reason.zh: 实证比较异步推理与动作衔接方案，主要研究模型部署和执行取舍。

primary_reason.en: It surveys models that couple future prediction with robot action, emphasizing control interfaces and deployment tradeoffs.
primary_reason.zh: 综述联合未来预测与机器人行动的模型，重点是控制接口和部署取舍。

primary_reason.en: It iteratively improves control through advantage-conditioned policies and real experience, contributing a learning method.
primary_reason.zh: 通过优势条件策略和真实交互经验迭代改进控制，主要贡献是学习方法。

primary_reason.en: It improves generalist robot-policy steerability through multimodal context and subgoal conditioning.
primary_reason.zh: 以多模态上下文和子目标增强通用机器人策略的可控性。

primary_reason.en: It connects flow-action denoising to online policy optimization, contributing reinforcement-learning fine-tuning for VLAs.
primary_reason.zh: 把流动作去噪接入在线策略优化，主要研究VLA强化学习微调。

primary_reason.en: It combines high-level world-model search with low-level action policies to deliver long-horizon robot control.
primary_reason.zh: 将高层世界模型搜索与低层动作策略结合，主要交付长时机器人控制。

primary_reason.en: It provides joint future prediction and action-conditioned simulation to evaluate consequences and correct candidate actions.
primary_reason.zh: 提供联合未来预测和动作条件模拟接口，用环境后果评估并修正候选动作。

primary_reason.en: It develops cross-layer data, communication, and computation optimizations for large-scale embodied-training infrastructure.
primary_reason.zh: 整理数据、通信与计算的跨层优化，主要贡献是大规模具身训练基础设施。

primary_reason.en: Its central contribution is a placement planner and execution engine for efficient distributed DiT training.
primary_reason.zh: 核心贡献是分布式 DiT 训练的序列放置规划与执行引擎，属于系统与执行效率。
核心贡献是保持训练语义的分布式块并行执行与通信优化。
primary_reason.en: The main contribution is a distributed block-parallel execution and communication scheme that preserves training semantics.

primary_reason.zh: 主要贡献覆盖长视频训练和推理的并行布局、数值精度及执行基础设施。
primary_reason.en: Its central contribution is parallel layout, numerical precision, and execution infrastructure for long-video training and inference.

primary_reason.zh: 主要贡献是可流式、可逐块控制的大规模自回归视频生成模型与训练配方。
primary_reason.en: The main contribution is a scalable autoregressive video model and training recipe for streaming and chunk-level control.

primary_reason.zh: 核心目标是面向物理 AI 的可控世界模拟、视觉预测与仿真数据生成。
primary_reason.en: Its main objective is controllable world simulation, visual prediction, and synthetic data generation for Physical AI.

primary_reason.zh: 论文整体贡献是成本有效的视频生成基础模型及其数据、训练和系统配方。
primary_reason.en: The overall contribution is a cost-effective video foundation model with integrated data, training, and systems recipes.

primary_reason.zh: 核心贡献是多镜头视频基础模型及其从数据、预训练到对齐和加速的整体配方。
primary_reason.en: The central contribution is a multi-shot video foundation model with a full recipe spanning data, pretraining, alignment, and acceleration.

primary_reason.zh: 核心贡献是数据与计算分离放置的动态并行执行系统。
primary_reason.en: Its main contribution is a dynamic parallel execution system that separates data placement from computation placement.

primary_reason.zh: 主要贡献是训练负载管理与 GPU 算子执行优化。
primary_reason.en: Its central contribution is training-load management combined with GPU-kernel optimization.

primary_reason.zh: 主要贡献是生产规模的动态并行调度与通信执行。
primary_reason.en: Its main contribution is scalable dynamic-parallel scheduling and communication execution.

primary_reason.zh: 核心贡献是注意力分离执行、细粒度调度与通信重叠系统。
primary_reason.en: Its core contribution is a system for attention disaggregation, fine-grained scheduling, and communication overlap.

primary_reason.zh: 核心贡献是面向变长训练负载的自适应并行规划系统。
primary_reason.en: Its central contribution is adaptive parallel planning for variable-length training workloads.

primary_reason.zh: 主要贡献是并行执行策略与训练数据分配的系统协同优化。
primary_reason.en: Its main contribution is a systems co-design of parallel execution strategies and training-data assignment.

primary_reason.zh: 核心贡献是大规模训练的动态并行网格、通信优化与调度系统。
primary_reason.en: Its core contribution is a dynamic parallel mesh, communication optimization, and scheduling system for large-scale training.

primary_reason.zh: 核心贡献是长上下文训练的分布式注意力执行原语。
primary_reason.en: Its main contribution is a distributed-attention execution primitive for long-context training.

primary_reason.zh: 核心贡献是跨机 DiT 推理的通信计算重叠与执行调度。
primary_reason.en: The core contribution is communication-computation overlap and execution scheduling for distributed DiT inference.
